body.message:
As our standard check-in time is 3:00 PM, we will share the check-in details between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM once the unit is ready. All relevant information, including unit details and parking allocation, will be provided on the check-in date once everything is prepared.

In the meantime, we will coordinate with the team to have the unit ready as early as possible and will keep you updated accordingly.
